verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details many Gemini Apps UI-only features (Gems, Deep Research, Connected Apps, Daily Brief, Live conversations, Notebooks, scheduling) with no corresponding API documentation showing these are exposed programmatically. Community evidence (e.g., gemini-comm-11) even notes the API/AI Studio path is more restricted (capped temperature, hidden top_k) than the full product, reinforcing that API and UI capability sets are not equivalent.
